paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.11% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+2.50%) and Dow Jones weakest (-0.72%). Brent crude changed -2.62% to 110.2. Gold changed -0.15% to 4,054.2. Bitcoin changed -0.93% to 80,317.1094. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.045%, a relative move of -1.96%. Among the firms tracked, Evercore (+16.02%) and Santander (-12.04%) moved the most.
